title: Delicate Bow
wikitext: {{Infobox mousehat |name = Delicate Bow |image = Delicate Bow.png |achievement = Cook |ad = [[Cooking|Cook]] 10 different recipes. |price = {{Price|1000}} }} The '''Delicate Bow''' is a [[Hats|hat]] that can be purchased from the [[Abandoned House]] for {{Price|1000}} after earning the "Cook" [[Achievements|Achievement]] ([[Cooking|cook]] 10 different recipes). It can also be obtained from [[Desert Festival#Emily's Outfit Services|Emily's outfit services]] at the [[Desert Festival]]. There is a ≈2% chance to receive the gender-neutral outfit with the Delicate Bow. ==Notes== * The Delicate Bow outfit also includes a [[File:Shirt092.png|24px|link=]] [[Tailoring#Shirts|Shirt]] and [[File:Skirt.png|24px|link=]] [[Tailoring#Pants|Skirt]] (dyed RGB value 242,87,105). ==References== Male players have 47 possible outfits (1/47 ≈ 2.13%), while female players have 48 possible ones (1/48 ≈ 2.08%). See Content\Data\MakeoverOutfits.xnb.
